description: Get a rendered map image (PNG) of a flight by fa_flight_id. Writes the PNG to disk (default: $AEROAPI_OUTPUT_DIR, else ~/Downloads/flightaware-mcp) and returns the path, or returns it inline as base64 when inline:true.

inline.description: Return the PNG inline as base64 instead of writing to disk

output_dir.description: Directory to write the PNG to (default: $AEROAPI_OUTPUT_DIR, else ~/Downloads/flightaware-mcp). Must be inside that default directory.

show_data_block.description: Overlay the flight data block on the map

name: fa_get_flight_map
